2993 source records · 7 monster identities (assassin, chief_goblin, female_goblin, male_goblin, robber, thug, warlord) · 6 semantic families · 1980 combat-mob frames (6 mobs × 330) + 210 boss frames (Warlord × 210) · 144 spritesheets · 295 components · 12 melee weapons · 18 slash FX · 2 dialogue UI · 332 source/support · Runtime: 0 · Reference: 2993 · Reviewed: 2993 · 0 unclassified
